mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_conversations (id, user_id, title, message_count, last_message_at, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{messageCount}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM qa_conversations WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM qa_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
